stories.title: Australia Orders Apple to Allow Rival App Stores on iPhone

stories.more: MacRumors highlights the court's ruling and its timeline, emphasizing the requirement for Apple to make changes following the court's August 2025 finding. 9to5Mac, on the other hand, frames the decision within the context of a long-running antitrust dispute with Epic Games and notes Apple's intention to appeal against the ruling. Both outlets agree on the core aspects of the ruling but differ in their focus on the implications of the Epic Games case and Apple's response.
